type AEPBundle struct {
	ID                 string            `json:"id"`
	SourceDirectory    string            `json:"source_directory"`
	Interpreter        string            `json:"interpreter"`
	InterpreterArgs    []string          `json:"interpreter_args,omitempty"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	Name               string            `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Version            string            `json:"version,omitempty"`
	SHA256             string            `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type AppSettings struct {
	Revision     uint64       `json:"revision"`
	Capabilities Capabilities `json:"capabilities"`
}

type AppSettingsStore interface {
	AppSettings(context.Context) (AppSettings, error)
	SaveAppSettings(context.Context, uint64, Capabilities) (AppSettings, error)
	WorkspaceApprovals(context.Context, string) ([]WorkspaceApproval, error)
	SaveWorkspaceApproval(context.Context, WorkspaceApproval) error
	DeleteWorkspaceApproval(context.Context, string, string, string) error
	ReplaceSessionCapabilities(context.Context, string, Capabilities) error
	SetSessionCapabilityEnabled(context.Context, string, string, string, bool) error
	SetCapabilityOverride(context.Context, string, bool, Capabilities) error
}

type Attempt struct {
	ModelOptions        ModelOptions           `json:"model_options,omitempty"`
	Wait                *engine.WaitCheckpoint `json:"wait,omitempty"`
	ID                  string                 `json:"id"`
	TurnID              string                 `json:"turn_id"`
	SessionID           string                 `json:"session_id"`
	BranchID            string                 `json:"branch_id"`
	Target              Target                 `json:"target"`
	NativeSessionID     string                 `json:"native_session_id"`
	Status              engine.Outcome         `json:"status"`
	SideEffectsPossible bool                   `json:"side_effects_possible"`
	Failure             engine.FailureKind     `json:"failure"`
	Error               string                 `json:"error"`
	CreatedAt           int64                  `json:"created_at"`
	EndedAt             int64                  `json:"ended_at"`
}

type Automation struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	AutomationDraft
	Enabled       bool   `json:"enabled"`
	Revision      uint64 `json:"revision"`
	BranchID      string `json:"branch_id"`
	Target        Target `json:"target"`
	NextRunAt     int64  `json:"next_run_at,omitempty"`
	LastRunAt     int64  `json:"last_run_at,omitempty"`
	LastStatus    string `json:"last_status"`
	LastError     string `json:"last_error,omitempty"`
	RunningTurnID string `json:"running_turn_id,omitempty"`
}

type AutomationBrowseStore interface {
	ListAutomationIndex(context.Context) ([]Automation, error)
}

type AutomationDraft struct {
	Title           string `json:"title"`
	Prompt          string `json:"prompt"`
	IntervalMinutes int64  `json:"interval_minutes"`
}

type AutomationStore interface {
	ListAutomations(context.Context, string) ([]Automation, error)
	Automation(context.Context, string, string) (Automation, error)
	CreateAutomation(context.Context, string, AutomationDraft) (Automation, error)
	UpdateAutomation(context.Context, string, string, uint64, AutomationDraft) (Automation, error)
	SetAutomationEnabled(context.Context, string, string, uint64, bool, bool) (Automation, error)
	DeleteAutomation(context.Context, string, string, uint64) error
	DueAutomations(context.Context, int64) ([]AutomationTick, error)
	ClaimAutomation(context.Context, AutomationTick, int64) (Claim, error)
	SkipBusyAutomation(context.Context, AutomationTick, int64) error
	PauseInvalidAutomation(context.Context, AutomationTick) error
}

type AutomationTick struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	Revision  uint64 `json:"revision"`
}

type Branch struct {
	ID              string `json:"id"`
	SessionID       string `json:"session_id"`
	Target          Target `json:"target"`
	NativeSessionID string `json:"native_session_id"`
	Watermark       uint64 `json:"watermark"`
	Parked          bool   `json:"parked"`
}

type BrowserSettings struct {
	Executable         string            `json:"executable"`
	Env                map[string]string `json:"env,omitempty"`
	Headless           bool              `json:"headless"`
	Proxy              string            `json:"proxy,omitempty"`
	StartupTimeoutMS   int               `json:"startup_timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	OperationTimeoutMS int               `json:"operation_timeout_ms,omitempty"`
	Enabled            bool              `json:"enabled"`
	HostAccessApproved bool              `json:"host_access_approved"`
}

type Capabilities struct {
	MCP              []MCPServer     `json:"mcp"`
	AEP              []AEPBundle     `json:"aep,omitempty"`
	SubagentsEnabled bool            `json:"subagents_enabled"`
	PersistentMemory bool            `json:"persistent_memory"`
	MediaEnabled     bool            `json:"media_enabled"`
	MediaDecoder     MediaDecoder    `json:"media_decoder"`
	Browser          BrowserSettings `json:"browser"`
	Commands         CommandSettings `json:"commands"`
	Tools            ToolSettings    `json:"tools"`
}

type CapabilityItem struct {
	Kind        string `json:"kind"`
	Item        string `json:"item"`
	Host        bool   `json:"host"`
	Enabled     bool   `json:"enabled"`
	Fingerprint string `json:"fingerprint,omitempty"`
}

type Claim struct {
	Session      Session
	Branch       Branch
	Turn         Turn
	Attempt      Attempt
	Handoff      *Handoff
	WaitRevision uint64
}

type CommandSettings struct {
	Hooks       []HookSpec       `json:"hooks"`
	Diagnostics []DiagnosticSpec `json:"diagnostics"`
}

type CompanionArchive struct {
	Profiles []CompanionProfile `json:"profiles"`
	Groups   []CompanionGroup   `json:"groups"`
}

type CompanionConversation struct {
	ID            string           `json:"id"`
	OwnerID       string           `json:"owner_id"`
	CompanionID   string           `json:"companion_id"`
	GroupID       string           `json:"group_id,omitempty"`
	GroupRevision uint64           `json:"group_revision,omitempty"`
	SessionID     string           `json:"session_id"`
	Profile       CompanionProfile `json:"profile"`
	CreatedAt     int64            `json:"created_at"`
}

type CompanionGroup struct {
	ID            string   `json:"id"`
	OwnerID       string   `json:"owner_id"`
	Revision      uint64   `json:"revision"`
	Name          string   `json:"name"`
	Members       []string `json:"members"`
	ScopeRevision uint64   `json:"scope_revision"`
	ReplyMode     string   `json:"reply_mode"`
	ReplyLimit    int      `json:"reply_limit"`
	Workspace     string   `json:"workspace"`
	Enabled       bool     `json:"enabled"`
	Deleted       bool     `json:"deleted,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt     int64    `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt     int64    `json:"updated_at"`
}

type CompanionHistoryQuery struct {
	Before string `json:"before,omitempty"`
	Limit  int    `json:"limit"`
}

type CompanionHistoryStore interface {
	CompanionArchive(context.Context, string) (CompanionArchive, error)
	CompanionMessagePage(context.Context, string, string, uint64, CompanionHistoryQuery) (CompanionMessagePage, error)
	CompanionRoundPage(context.Context, string, string, uint64, CompanionHistoryQuery) (CompanionRoundPage, error)
}

type CompanionMessage struct {
	ID            string `json:"id"`
	RoundID       string `json:"round_id"`
	GroupID       string `json:"group_id"`
	GroupRevision uint64 `json:"group_revision"`
	CompanionID   string `json:"companion_id,omitempty"`
	Author        string `json:"author"`
	Text          string `json:"text"`
	SessionID     string `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
	TurnID        string `json:"turn_id,omitempty"`
	Status        string `json:"status"`
	CreatedAt     int64  `json:"created_at"`
}

type CompanionMessagePage struct {
	Messages   []CompanionMessage `json:"messages"`
	NextBefore string             `json:"next_before,omitempty"`
	HasMore    bool               `json:"has_more"`
}

type CompanionProfile struct {
	ID               string           `json:"id"`
	OwnerID          string           `json:"owner_id"`
	Revision         uint64           `json:"revision"`
	Name             string           `json:"name"`
	Role             string           `json:"role"`
	Target           Target           `json:"target"`
	PermissionPolicy PermissionPolicy `json:"permission_policy"`
	Workspace        string           `json:"workspace,omitempty"`
	Skills           []CompanionSkill `json:"skills,omitempty"`
	Enabled          bool             `json:"enabled"`
	Deleted          bool             `json:"deleted,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        int64            `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt        int64            `json:"updated_at"`
}

type CompanionRound struct {
	OperationID         string                  `json:"operation_id"`
	Revision            uint64                  `json:"revision"`
	NextMember          int                     `json:"next_member"`
	Stage               string                  `json:"stage"`
	ActiveBranchID      string                  `json:"active_branch_id,omitempty"`
	ActiveTurnID        string                  `json:"active_turn_id,omitempty"`
	BeforeTurnID        string                  `json:"before_turn_id,omitempty"`
	PendingPromptSHA256 string                  `json:"pending_prompt_sha256,omitempty"`
	ID                  string                  `json:"id"`
	OwnerID             string                  `json:"owner_id"`
	GroupID             string                  `json:"group_id"`
	GroupRevision       uint64                  `json:"group_revision"`
	Prompt              string                  `json:"prompt"`
	Members             []CompanionConversation `json:"members"`
	Status              string                  `json:"status"`
	Error               string                  `json:"error,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt           int64                   `json:"created_at"`
	EndedAt             int64                   `json:"ended_at"`
}

type CompanionRoundPage struct {
	Rounds     []CompanionRound `json:"rounds"`
	NextBefore string           `json:"next_before,omitempty"`
	HasMore    bool             `json:"has_more"`
}

type CompanionSkill struct {
	SourceSessionID string `json:"source_session_id"`
	SourceBranchID  string `json:"source_branch_id"`
	Name            string `json:"name"`
	SHA256          string `json:"sha256"`
	GroupAllowed    bool   `json:"group_allowed"`
}

type CompanionSkillScope struct {
	Skills []CompanionSkill `json:"skills"`
}

type CompanionStore interface {
	Companions(context.Context, string) ([]CompanionProfile, error)
	Companion(context.Context, string, string) (CompanionProfile, error)
	SaveCompanion(context.Context, CompanionProfile, uint64) (CompanionProfile, error)
	DeleteCompanion(context.Context, string, string, uint64) error
	CompanionGroups(context.Context, string) ([]CompanionGroup, error)
	CompanionGroup(context.Context, string, string) (CompanionGroup, error)
	SaveCompanionGroup(context.Context, CompanionGroup, uint64) (CompanionGroup, error)
	DeleteCompanionGroup(context.Context, string, string, uint64) error
	CompanionSession(context.Context, string) (CompanionConversation, error)
	CompanionConversation(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64) (CompanionConversation, error)
	OpenCompanionConversation(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (CompanionConversation, error)
	BeginCompanionRound(context.Context, string, string, uint64, string, []string) (CompanionRound, error)
	CompanionRound(context.Context, string, string) (CompanionRound, error)
	SaveCompanionRoundProgress(context.Context, string, CompanionRound, uint64) (CompanionRound, error)
	PublishCompanionReply(context.Context, string, string, uint64, CompanionMessage) (CompanionRound, error)
	FinishCompanionRound(context.Context, string, string, string, string) error
	AppendCompanionMessage(context.Context, string, CompanionMessage) error
	CompanionMessages(context.Context, string, string, uint64, int) ([]CompanionMessage, error)
	CompanionRounds(context.Context, string, string, uint64, int) ([]CompanionRound, error)
	RecoverCompanions(context.Context) error
}

type ComposerDraft struct {
	Scope            ComposerDraftScope       `json:"scope"`
	Revision         uint64                   `json:"revision"`
	Text             string                   `json:"text"`
	PendingSessionID string                   `json:"pending_session_id,omitempty"`
	References       []ComposerDraftReference `json:"references,omitempty"`
	PreparedCommands json.RawMessage          `json:"prepared_commands,omitempty"`
}

type ComposerDraftAdmissionStore interface {
	CreateComposerSession(context.Context, ComposerDraft, string, string, Target) (Session, ComposerDraft, error)
}

type ComposerDraftReference struct {
	Kind   string `json:"kind"`
	ID     string `json:"id"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
}

type ComposerDraftScope struct {
	Kind string `json:"kind"`
	ID   string `json:"id"`
}

type ComposerDraftStore interface {
	ComposerDraft(context.Context, ComposerDraftScope) (ComposerDraft, error)
	SaveComposerDraft(context.Context, ComposerDraft, uint64) (ComposerDraft, error)
}

type ComposerExecutionStore interface {
	BeginComposerTurn(context.Context, string, string, ComposerTurnInput) (Claim, error)
}

type ComposerFile struct {
	ID              string             `json:"id"`
	Scope           ComposerDraftScope `json:"scope"`
	Name            string             `json:"name"`
	SourcePath      string             `json:"source_path"`
	MediaType       string             `json:"media_type"`
	SHA256          string             `json:"sha256"`
	Bytes           int64              `json:"bytes"`
	OriginalKey     string             `json:"original_key"`
	ChunkSHA256     []string           `json:"chunk_sha256"`
	Text            bool               `json:"is_text"`
	TextKey         string             `json:"text_key,omitempty"`
	TextBytes       int64              `json:"text_bytes,omitempty"`
	TextSHA256      string             `json:"text_sha256,omitempty"`
	TextChunkSHA256 []string           `json:"text_chunk_sha256,omitempty"`
	Processing      string             `json:"processing"`
	CreatedAt       int64              `json:"created_at"`
}

type ComposerFileOwnershipStore interface {
	ComposerFileSession(context.Context, string, string, string) (bool, error)
}

type ComposerFileStore interface {
	SaveComposerFile(context.Context, ComposerFile) (ComposerFile, error)
	ComposerFile(context.Context, string) (ComposerFile, error)
	ListComposerFiles(context.Context, ComposerDraftScope, int) ([]ComposerFile, error)
}

type ComposerTurnInput struct {
	Prompt   string
	UserText string
	Files    []engine.InputFile
	Skills   []engine.InputSkill
}

	BaseCommit    string           `json:"base_commit"`
	WorkerSHA256  string           `json:"worker_sha256"`
	SharedSHA256  string           `json:"shared_sha256"`
	PatchSHA256   string           `json:"patch_sha256"`
	PatchBytes    int              `json:"patch_bytes"`
	SnapshotBytes int              `json:"snapshot_bytes"`
	CreatedAt     int64            `json:"created_at"`
	Changes       []WorktreeChange `json:"changes"`
}

type WorktreeRemovalReview struct {
	WorkerSHA256 string `json:"worker_sha256"`
	IndexSHA256  string `json:"index_sha256"`
	Head         string `json:"head"`
	Files        int    `json:"files"`
	Bytes        int    `json:"bytes"`
	CreatedAt    int64  `json:"created_at"`
}

type WorktreeScope struct {
	RepositoryID string `json:"repository_id"`
	Path         string `json:"path"`
}

type WorktreeStore interface {
	BeginWorkerWorktree(context.Context, string, string, string) (Worker, error)
	FinishWorkerWorktree(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, WorktreeBinding, string) (Worker, error)
	SaveWorkerEvidence(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, WorktreeEvidence) (Worker, error)
	BeginWorkerAdoption(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (Worker, error)
	FinishWorkerAdoption(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (Worker, error)
	SaveWorkerRemovalReview(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, WorktreeRemovalReview) (Worker, error)
	BeginWorkerRemoval(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, string) (Worker, error)
	FinishWorkerRemoval(context.Context, string, string, string, uint64, bool) (Worker, error)
}

var ErrAppSettingsConflict = errors.New("application settings changed; reload before saving")

var ErrAutomationRouteChanged = errors.New("automation paused because its route or collaboration scope changed")

var ErrAutomationSkipped = errors.New("automation tick skipped; no catch-up or queued execution")

var ErrAutomationStale = errors.New("automation changed, paused, claimed or not due; refresh before acting")

var ErrCompanionConflict = errors.New("companion configuration changed; reload before saving")

var ErrCompanionDisabled = errors.New("companion or group is disabled")

var ErrComposerDraftConflict = errors.New("composer draft changed; reload the shared draft before saving")

var ErrComposerFileChanged = errors.New("captured composer file identity or bytes changed")

var ErrConnectionConflict = errors.New("model connection changed; reload before saving")

var ErrConnectionCreationConflict = errors.New("connection creation changed or its connection was edited or deleted; resolve the original request")

var ErrConversationTabsConflict = errors.New("conversation tabs changed; reload the worktree before saving")

var ErrDeveloperRepositoryConflict = errors.New("developer repository identity changed; refresh explicit imports")

var ErrGoalConflict = errors.New("goal request changed; use a new request identity")

var ErrGoalScope = errors.New("goal belongs to a different project or session")

var ErrInvalidGoal = errors.New("invalid goal")

var ErrInvalidPreferences = errors.New("invalid application preferences")

var ErrModelPreferenceConflict = errors.New("model preference changed; reload before saving")

var ErrNotFound = errors.New("product object is unavailable in this scope")

var ErrPreferenceConflict = errors.New("preferences changed; reload before saving")

var ErrSessionBusy = errors.New("Hub session already running")

var ErrSessionModelOptionsConflict = errors.New("session model options changed; reload before saving")

var ErrSessionNotRunning = errors.New("Hub session is not running")

var ErrWorkerDormant = errors.New("Worker is dormant or Team has ended")

var ErrWorkerQueueEmpty = errors.New("Worker queue is empty")

var ErrWorkerResourcesBlocked = errors.New("Worker head is waiting for older or running resource claims")

var ErrWorkspaceViewConflict = errors.New("workspace view changed in another window; reload before saving")
